text:
Ava (partnerships): Quick pulse check before vendor sync tomorrow. Main topics: per-region power/thermal constraints for H100/H200/B200/MI300/Gaudi, SKU staging for marketplace, and a staggered announcement timeline. Can we surface any last-minute blockers?

Ravi (hw-ops): Blocker: H200 BIOS v2.4 rollout still has a couple of enclaves failing thermal validation under sustained 8h load. Patch reduces peak by ~7% but those enclaves need airflow tweaks. Logs in /mnt/lab/hw-thermal-042.

Lina (marketplace): Marketplace requirement: we must have final AMI/container image tags + SKU metadata 72 hours before soft announce. If a region slips we can publish hidden SKUs and flip visibility at go-live. Also need a stable health endpoint for canary checks.

Miguel (platform): Runtime ops: we can implement region gating (NA->EU->APAC) and a 24h canary per region. Also recommend an automatic fallback to a quantized model (q4_k/8) if throttling exceeds threshold. I'll prepare a PR with feature flags.

Ravi (hw-ops): Thermal snapshot (lab quick table):
```
Device  | BIOS/FW   | Peak (W) | Sustained (W)
H100    | BIOS 1.9  | 640      | 510
H200    | BIOS 2.4  | 715      | 600 (after patch)
B200    | BIOS 1.7  | 480      | 390
MI300   | FW 3.2    | 690      | 570
Gaudi   | revB      | 410      | 350
```

Ava (partnerships): Proposed announce windows: NA April 9 (soft), EU April 11, APAC April 14 (final). Lina can you stage hidden SKUs + health-check urls for those windows?

Lina (marketplace): I can stage hidden SKUs. Need final tag names and health URLs. I'll also add a toggle playbook and rollback steps for SKU visibility.

Miguel (platform): On routing: suggest threshold = GPU package power sustained > 92% for 2 minutes OR GPU temp > 80C for 90s. Fallback path will route to q4_k8 variant and send an alert to #eng-oncall.

Ravi (hw-ops): Agreed. I'll validate those thresholds in lab-rt-24 and upload the validation matrix. Also will document the airflow/fan-curve changes for DC-C racks.

Ava (partnerships): Action list: (1) Ravi finalize BIOS cutoff + upload rollback plan, (2) Lina create hidden SKUs, image tags, and health endpoints, (3) Miguel open feature-flag PR and routing policy, (4) Partnerships draft embargo text for vendor/press and coordinate with legal. Target: close by tomorrow 10:00 PT.

announce-bot: Calendar invite created for vendor-sync: 2026-04-02 10:00 PT  https://calendar.redwood.example/def :spiral_calendar:

Lina (marketplace): I'll populate the invite with the checklist and tag owners.

Miguel (platform): I'll drop the routing policy stub into the PR and include tests.

Ravi (hw-ops): Uploading logs and BIOS matrix now. Will ping when done.

Ava (partnerships): Thanks team  we'll resolve blockers in the sync.
